name: RSI-pullback re-entry in an uptrend — 1h swing cadence
rationale: MECHANISM: same buy-the-dip continuation as the 15m variant (in a confirmed uptrend, a shallow RSI pullback is a liquidity event where trend-followers add and shorts cover, so price resumes up; reversal-faders are the counterparty) but on a 1h bar for a swing cadence with a longer hold — fewer, deeper pullbacks, lower fee churn, larger continuation legs. Entry: rsi below a fitted dip floor AND positive ret_Nd AND adx above a floor (uptrend confirmed). DISCONFIRMER: kill if removing the uptrend gate (ret_Nd + adx) leaves the edge intact — then it is a reversion trade misfiled here, and crypto reversion is largely arbitraged away. Kill if it also wins symmetrically as an overbought SHORT (rsi = pure reversion, not continuation). Must ONLY work as a dip-buy conditional on the uptrend.
catalyst: shallow RSI dip inside a confirmed uptrend, swing cadence
